excerpt:
background(cleanUp)
scenario('Should_RejectClaim_When_PoolExhausted', scope.pipe(
  When('claiming from an empty pool')('result', ({ shell }) => shell.execute(new ClaimCommand({ who: ALICE, dim: GAME })).pipe(Effect.either)),
  Then('returns PoolExhaustedError')(({ result }) => expect(result).toMatchObject(Either.left({ _tag: 'PoolExhaustedError' }))),
why: Edge case: no Given is needed because the background really empties the store; the empty state is true, not claimed.
The only fake is a third-party port, built as a service with failure controls and read-back operations; every first-party shell runs its real layer.
